title: M5 stage12: ordinary gcd properties and exact complete-signature lift
scope: Section5 gcd/period integration; original complete signature and repeated factors retained

spec.name: M5.Signature.binary_monic
spec.guidance: Any nonzero coefficient in ZMod2 is1. Prove the closed finite auxiliary ∀c:ZMod2,c≠0→c=1 by decide. Apply it to leadingCoeff using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero and unfold Polynomial.Monic. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Signature.binary_dvd_antisymm
spec.statement: ∀ P Q : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ∣ Q → Q ∣ P → P = Q
spec.guidance: If either polynomial is zero, divisibility gives both zero. Otherwise binary_monic gives monicity of both; use Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated and associated_of_dvd_dvd. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Signature.divisor_constant_one
spec.statement: ∀ P a : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ∣ a → a.coeff 0 = 1 → P.coeff 0 = 1
spec.guidance: Write a=P*q and apply Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero. The finite ZMod2 statement ∀c d,c*d=1→c=1 is decidable by plain decide. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Signature.ordinary_gcd_properties
spec.statement: ∀ a b : M5.BinaryPolynomial, a.coeff 0 = 1 → b.coeff 0 = 1 → (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b).Monic ∧ (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b).coeff 0 = 1 ∧ (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b).natDegree ≤ b.natDegree
spec.guidance: Anchored coefficients imply a and b nonzero. EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_zero_iff gives nonzero gcd. Apply binary_monic, divisor_constant_one with gcd_dvd_left, and Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd using b nonzero and gcd_dvd_right. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Signature.exact_signature_lift
spec.statement: ∀ (a b : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T E j : ℕ), EuclideanDomain.gcd a b ∣ M5.cyclicModulus E → M5.completeSignature a b (T+j*E) = M5.completeSignature a b T
spec.guidance: Unfold completeSignature and use binary_dvd_antisymm. In each direction EuclideanDomain.dvd_gcd combines the automatic gcd-divides-G fact with M5.Lift.common_divisors_lift (already imported accepted theorem) applied to the candidate gcd divisor. This gives actual gcd equality, preserving repeated factors, from the earlier conditional common-divisor lift. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Signature.ordinary_gcd_period_bound
spec.statement: ∀ a b : M5.BinaryPolynomial, a.coeff 0 = 1 → b.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.signaturePeriod (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b) ∧ M5.signaturePeriod (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b) ≤ 2 ^ b.natDegree
spec.guidance: Use ordinary_gcd_properties for monic/constant1/degree bound. M5.Period.period_law gives positivity; M5.Period.period_cardinality_bound gives ≤2^degreeG. Monotonicity of powers in the exponent gives the stated second-block bound. These imported period theorems are in M5Accepted. Return only tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
